sentences.text: 1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2.  The present petition has been filed seeking following relief:-
"i. Set aside the Impugned order dated 04.08.2023, Passed By The Ld.ASJ, (North West), Rohini Courts, Delhi, Granting Anticipatory Bail Under Section 498A/406/34 IPC in FIR No. 0040/2023 Ps: Shalimar Bagh, To Sanjay Lekhwani/Respondent No 2, Lata Lekhwani/Respondent No 3, Chand Motiyani /Respondent No 4 And Gunjan Motiyani/Respondent No 5 And As A Consequence Taking The Respondent No 2-5 In Custody."
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits the respondent nos.2 to 5, who are the husband and in-laws of the petitioners have been granted This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/01/2024 at 17:40:31 anticipatory bail on the ground that the complainant has mortgaged her jewellery to Muthoot Finance and there is no jewellery which is required to be recovered from the custodial interrogation of the respondent nos.2 to 5.
4.

He submits that the learned Trial Court has failed to appreciate that the receipts of mortgage of the said jewellery articles were produced before the IO by the husband of the complainant, which itself shows that the mortgage, if any, was created by the husband of the complainant.
5. Additionally, he submits that there is likely possibility of settlement being arrived at between the parties in case they are referred to the senior mediator of the Mediation Centre of this Court.
